evidence.description: Captured searchParams from useSearchParams; added else-if branch: when tabs.length===0 and searchParams.has('tab'), delete the tab param with replace:true. Loop prevention: the guard on searchParams.has('tab') is false once the param is cleared, so the effect does not re-fire.

Added regression test 'clears stale tab param when config is loaded and no tabs are available': renders with all ES-gated flags off (empty tabs), asserts setSearchParams called with a replace updater that deletes the tab key while preserving unrelated params.
